why: The two N/A branches of the rule, one per folder. `pass/` has no LICENSE: a missing license is the failure of the `license` rule, and accusing here again would count the same debt twice in the denominator. `fail/` has an MIT LICENSE: the obligation to pass the NOTICE along comes from section 4(d) of Apache-2.0 and from no other license, so demanding it of an MIT project would be inventing a clause it never signed. The two sides come out N/A for different reasons, and swapping either one for `passou` makes the case accuse. `passou` stays Portuguese: it is the state value prove.mjs matches on (prove.mjs:198-200), not prose.
